name: 48201 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48201 (Detroit) has 193 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (10% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48201 (Detroit) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48201 (Detroit) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
